conf.description: PACS Badge System (OnGuard class exemplar) system-health / api-pull: decode Time and the Lnl_Panel.Status / Lnl_Reader.Status bitmasks into named boolean conditions per recommendations.direct.cribl, keep the raw bitmask too, leave Lnl_Panel.Name unmapped (join-only field, no lookup CSV).

conf.comment: pacs-badge / system-health / api-pull. Per recommendations.direct.cribl: decode the panel/reader hardware-status bitmasks into named boolean conditions at the edge worker group. The vendor field names Lnl_Panel.Status / Lnl_Reader.Status use dot notation whose wire shape (genuinely nested vs a flat dotted key) is not specified by the map, so this pipeline reads both forms defensively rather than guessing (see THE BIG ONE / dotted-key trap). Transition-only emission and per-panel last-seen tracking are also asked for by the recommendation but require stateful cross-event correlation this environment has no backing store for - out of scope per the brief, documented in README; every poll is emitted as a discrete event here. Lnl_Panel.Name requires a join with no lookup CSV available - unmapped.

functions.description: if the REST collector delivered raw JSON text, parse it; a collector that already emits structured fields leaves this a no-op

parse Time to _time, normalize Description into event.action, defensively read Lnl_Panel.Status/Lnl_Reader.Status as either a nested or a flat dotted key and decode each documented bit into a named boolean condition plus the raw bitmask, tag category/dataset
batch every clean-path field that is a straight copy to its custom target
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
